description: List the full MeshMarket catalog: every active capability an agent can rent, with slug, name, kind (tool|feed|workflow), category, price in MESH per call, and lifetime call count, ordered by most-called (top 60), optionally filtered to one category. Free and keyless. Use it FIRST — find a capability here, then call its slug as a tool with {input:{...}} (capability calls are paid; mesh_signup mints a key). Returns {count, capabilities:[{slug,name,kind,category,price,calls}], note}.

category.description: return only capabilities in this category (case-insensitive exact match, e.g. 'commerce', 'memory', 'reasoning'); omit for the full catalog

name: mesh_discover
title: Browse the Catalog
